The center of the coin depicts the sun and the moon, representing the spring equinox that occurs on the day of Navruz. The sun and moon are surrounded by the branches and petals of a flowering almond tree, one of the heralds of spring.
On the outer circumference of the coin there is a two-line poem by the great poet and thinker Alisher Navi
